Red Flag Warning in Effect from Thursday, October 15 - Saturday, October 17
Get Prepared NOW
A Red Flag Warning is in effect for Agoura Hills and much of Los Angeles and Ventura counties from 6 a.m. Thursday, October 15, through 8 p.m. Saturday, October 17.
Forecast conditions include:
• Northeast winds of 20–30 mph, with gusts of 40–50 mph and isolated gusts up to 60 mph in the hills
• Very low humidity, with levels dropping to 5–15%
These conditions can cause fires to spread rapidly and behave unpredictably. Any new fire start could threaten lives and property.
The time is now to Know Your Evacuation Zone: protect.genasys.com and to sign-up for Emergency Alerts: agourahillscity.gov/alerts
